verdict.rationale: The only first-party spending controls in the evidence are budgets and spend control on AI Gateway model traffic. Platform pricing docs describe per-unit on-demand charges past included amounts, with no documented hard cap, and a community report of surprise $10k bills suggests overall cloud spend is not capped. Missing for 10: documented hard spending limits across platform compute, bandwidth and CDN usage; evidence that limits pause or stop usage rather than just monitor it; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set hard spending limits to control my cloud costs
